text:
tanya: Quick follow-up from last night's DB fail — I sketched a tiny '48h tidy-up' to close low-effort actions and reduce noise. Thoughts?

ajay: curious to see the checklist. want it to be explicit about owners and deadlines.

tanya: yep. propose: 1) triage leftover alerts (2h) 2) add short-term circuit-breaker (4h) 3) confirm runbook update (8h) 4) schedule longer RCA split (owner + ETA).

maria: +1 on owners. for (2) I can take the circuit-breaker PR today.

incident-bot: Follow-up task created: INC-4322 (48h tidy-up) assigned to maria, tanya, ajay. https://internal/tasks/INC-4322

lucas: can we keep the public comms minimal? ops page already updated. only update customers if SLA at risk.

tanya: agreed. comms cadence: internal thread -> 24h brief -> 48h final status. only customer msg if material impact.

ajay: suggest we tag the runbook change with a tiny test step so oncall can validate quickly. e.g. `curl -sS http://health/db-check | jq .status`

maria: PR up: https://git/repo/patch123 — includes the breaker and a smoke-check. pinged reviewers.

tanya: excellent. who owns the 72h follow-up to see if recurrence pattern shows up? need someone to look at alert clusters.

lucas: I can take recurrence analysis. will pull alert hist for last 90d and surface anomalies by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: let's also add a lightweight tracker for each postmortem action: fields = owner, ETA, risk, verification-step. one-line per task.

tanya: I'll make the tracker and put it under the incident doc. short template: `owner | ETA | quick-verify | notes`

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 24h for INC-4322.

maria: thumbs up. if nothing else, this should help avoid long tail churn. :thumbsup:

tanya: thanks team — I'll post the 48h checklist now and mark owners. we'll reconvene in 24h on this thread.

ajay: +1 — love the compact approach. less noise, faster closure.

lucas: adding a note to the runbook: "if DB fail spike, enable breaker and run smoke-check" — will open PR after analysis.

tanya: perfect. closing loop: tracker link: https://docs.redwood/incident/INC-4322/tidy-up (I put the template there).
